title: docs(pm-skill): platform-readings diet — delete the readings a scripts/pm tool now holds (tool first, text second)
body:
Fixes #22452
Clause-②: no

W1 of the skills-lane diet program; the program anchor #22060 remains open for its later work items. Tool first, text second: every reading in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` that a `scripts/pm` tool now holds is deleted whole, each one named below with the tool and the self-test case that pins it. Nothing else in the file moves, no other reference file is edited, and no tool's judgement changes. The file's `CEILINGS` row in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is lowered to the landed count.

## The table: reading, the tool that holds it, action

Line numbers are the file at `origin/main` `243dd3c62`.

| reading (first words, base line) | held by: tool, self-test battery and case | action |
|---|---|---|
| L91 「落地相邻的写侧一则:GitHub 标签描述上限 100 字符…」 | `scripts/pm/check-label-desc-cap.mjs` (`pnpm check:pm-label-desc-cap`, required in `lint.yml`): battery `check-label-desc-cap self-test`, cases `exactly 100 characters passes` and `101 characters fails` | deleted |
| L104 「官方指引:变更类请求间停 ~1 秒,mutation 按 5 倍计…」 | `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs` rule ① (`DEFAULT_MIN_GAP_MS` 3 s, above the ~1 s the text prescribed) and rule ⑤: batteries `rule ①: the remainder is slept, and the pause is said out loud` and `rule ⑤: batch mode — the gap rises for an announced batch, and the estimate is printed` | deleted |
| L105 「批量重分诊这类把写挤在同一秒的扫动…」 | `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs` rules ① and ④: batteries `rule ①: the remainder is slept, and the pause is said out loud` and `rule ④: the lease — one write in flight, fleet-wide, measured on real processes` | deleted |
| L107 「`write-pace` 把一次 dispatch 记作那一笔写(40/时不变)…」 | `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs` battery `rule ②: the 41st is REFUSED, with a prescription`; `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` battery `the wiring: the POST is paced and on the roster, the reads are not, the token never reaches the log`; `scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs` battery `the relay pack: ONE card, ONE dispatch — comment → labels_remove → issue_patch — ONE write on the throttle` (the text's 「每步一次 dispatch」 was already stale against it) | deleted |
| L122 「判别式:该 415 的 `documentation_url` 指 Claude Code 不指 GitHub…」 | `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs` `isProxyRefusal`: battery `rule ③: what writes a stop marker, how long it lasts, what it refuses`, case `⭐ the egress PROXY's 403 is recognised by its body (measured shape): the message naming the proxy, or a documentation_url that is not GitHub's`; `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` battery `the classifier: a 404 that is success, and a 403 that must not fall back`, case `⭐ a 403 whose body is the egress PROXY's (measured shape) is the ROUTE — prerequisite — ⛔ never a rate limit, whatever the header says` | deleted |
| L232 「摘标签也没有加法端点:`finding` 定级这类只能整组写…」 | `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` removes by directed `DELETE /issues/{n}/labels/{name}`: battery `the arithmetic: union, difference, and the two idempotent no-ops`, case `…one directed DELETE per removal actually present`; battery `the classifier: a 404 that is success, and a 403 that must not fall back`, case `a 404 on a DIRECTED DELETE is the label already being gone`; relay `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` battery `the idempotent removal: a 404 on a directed label DELETE is success` (the text's claim was stale against both) | deleted |
| L359 「平台在尾部 `---` 前后正反两向归一空行:比对正文只按首个差异偏移…」 | `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` exact-bytes classifier: battery `the re-anchored footer: a newline the platform MOVED is not a byte lost`, case `⛔ …so "equal length" is NOT the test and never became one`; battery `the collapsed blank: the footer block's own separator is not a content byte`; every relay body op is read back through that classifier (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` battery `the verdict: post-stamped's own classifier, imported — …`) | deleted |
| L360 「送全块即触发该归一 ⇒ `post-stamped` 的 `body` 档把这点空白判 `mutated`…」 | `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` battery `the collapsed blank: the footer block's own separator is not a content byte`, cases `…and it LANDED: exit 0, ⛔ not the 4 this exact shape answered on every one of them` and `…named by its OWN word, ⛔ never the re-anchor's, which says nothing was lost` (the tool no longer judges this `mutated`; the text was stale) | deleted |
| L419 「内联双引号 JSON 建卡:标题反引号标识符被 shell 以 root 展开…」 | `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` battery `the arguments: files not argv for prose, exactly one title source, a repo shape`, case `⛔ a --title carrying a backtick or a dollar sign is refused — the shell already had its turn` | deleted |

Nine bullets, each deleted whole; no fragment of a bullet was cut and nothing was re-wrapped.

## The rule, stated once

Head line 3 is replaced in place (one line for one line, 118 bytes, under the ratchet's 120-byte line rule): 「见 reading-discipline.md;工具先行、文本其次:读数先落工具或自测行,工具守不住的才留本表。」 `git grep -n '工具先行'` over `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` answers 1 hit, this line; `tool first` and `text second` answer 0.

The file's `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin stays 0 (it carries no table row).

## Gates, all run at `e74ef6211` after the final commit

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0: `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet self-test: 157 cases pass.`, `… platform-readings.md is 460 lines (ceiling 460; headroom 0).`, `cross-file move into … platform-readings.md: +2 (314→460, less 144 lines of ordinary ruled raise) against a net source decrease of 20`.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` exit 0: `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 34 file(s) clean`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths, change set from the merge base) derived 39 families; all 39 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` answers `39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt), then exit 0 after building those two. `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier) exit 0: `1825 cases pass; 6 slow section(s) deferred`.
- Outside the derived set, run because they read the edited ratchet or were named in the dispatch: `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`, `pnpm check:merged-result`, `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs`, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch expected the stamp contract, relative comment ids, the AND-label listing, the title byte cap, the ONE-OF guard, the four-step label write, the no-run UNCONFIRMED rule and the H rows in this file. Measured at `243dd3c62`, none of them is stated here, except the MCP list-union reading (L269 to L275), which is an MCP channel measurement and stays. So the diet is nine lines, not a section rewrite.
- Kept on purpose, with the reason each stays (doubt keeps a reading):
  - L106, the relay timings: the `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` header says neither ceiling is a measured start latency yet, so this file holds the only record of the probe.
  - L228 to L230, the MCP `issue_write` whole-set hazards: the `label-write.mjs` header cites them as its measured basis.
  - L231, the 403-session additive reading: `label-write.mjs` sends a proxy-shaped 403 to PREREQUISITE with no fallback, so it does not hold the reading as written.
  - L340 to L358, the PR-body footer cells: `AGENTS.md` points here, and `PR_CREATE_FOOTER_TAIL` in `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` cites the fourth shape.
  - L361, the report parse rule: H52 parses the balanced object, which is not the last-right-brace rule the text states.
  - L363 to L367, the clause-② and `Claim:` marker readings: no self-test pins the tolerated prefixes, and `post-stamped.mjs` passes a bolded claim line unjudged.
  - L412 to L418, the issue footer and PATCH cells: the `post-stamped.mjs` header cites them as the governed fact table.
  - L420, the heredoc expansion: the hazard happens while writing the file, before any tool reads it.
  - L429 and L430, the shallow `check-governed-merges` refusal: the tool holds the refusal, but L430 is an instruction no tool holds.
- Latent ratchet trap for the next diet: the `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` entry for this file records 144 lines of ordinary ruled raises above its `was` of 314. Any ceiling of 457 or less reds `crossFileMoveVerdict` as an over-claim until a `ruledRaises` record is retired. Measured with the exported function on the live map: 460 and 458 green, 457 and 440 red. This PR lowers by 9 and stays clear. A deeper diet must retire records in the same edit, and that is a change to `CROSS_FILE_MOVES`, not to a `CEILINGS` row.
- Drift noticed, not filed (prose only, no reader acts on it): the `post-stamped.mjs` header cites this file as `:410` and `:411`, but those readings sat at L414 and L415 before this PR and sit at L406 and L407 after it. L429 prescribes `git fetch --shallow-since=`, while `check-governed-merges` prints `fetch --unshallow` and `git-history.mjs` records that `--shallow-since` can shorten history. `rest-channel.md` keeps its own request-body prescription (never inline double-quoted strings), which is related to the deleted L419 but is not the same reading. Carrier: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:PM 技能的平台读数表删掉 9 条已由 `scripts/pm` 工具自动把关的条目(写入节流、中继计数、代理拒绝判别、按名摘标签、页脚回读、标签描述长度、标题反引号),并在表头写明「工具先行、文本其次」;该文件行数上限 469 → 460。
- **为什么改**:这张表每个席位每次运行都要整读;工具已经拦住的事再写一遍只是重复花阅读成本,且其中 4 条已与工具实际行为不符,留着反而误导。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:只删文字、不改任何工具判定;每条删除都对应一个具名自测用例。回滚 = 还原本 PR 这一个提交(两文件)。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:扫一眼上方「The table」的 9 行,对哪条删除有异议就在本 PR 评论点名行号;无异议则不必动手,本 PR 属 Tier S,由技能席位达档复核后经队列落地。
